subject: Kickoff: AndroidControl generalization benchmark
body:
Hi Alina, team,

Kickoff for the AndroidControl work. The dataset is over 15,000 human demonstrations across 833 apps spanning 40 app categories, and it's deliberately structured to measure whether agents generalize beyond the apps and tasks they were trained on — that's the property we actually need, not another in-distribution score.

Each episode carries screenshots, accessibility trees, high-level goals and low-level step instructions, and actions as JSON dictionaries. So we can evaluate our device-control agent on both instruction granularities without new annotation.

Milestones: TFRecord ingest and split parity by end of March, first agent evaluation mid-April, generalization readout the week of May 11.

Ulla
